audit.why: 49.8% over 1016 games with diff 5.5/10 EVEN is consistent. Annie's stun threat inside 625 range against a Vladimir whose only escape is a 28s Sanguine Pool at rank 1 is a genuine coin-flip lane that tilts to him with items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers rendered different level charts. phases[].side read Annie/Annie/Annie/Skill/Annie/Vladimir/Vladimir; win[] read Skill/Skill/Skill/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie.
audit.why: win[] matches packet.levelChart exactly and matches the phase whys (early phases describe stacking and threat, not a lead). Six of seven rows disagreed, so the page answered 'who wins Level 1' two different ways.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3], [5] and [6] .side realigned to the win[] chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool's untargetability was described vaguely and its cooldown stated as fifteen seconds. Grievous Wounds was mentioned only in itemization, never tied to the trade pattern.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s and grants 2 seconds untargetable — it eats a landed Pyromania stun's follow-up and Tibbers damage outright, which is the single interaction that decides every all-in. Transfusion costs 0 mana and heals, and both it and Hemoplague heal him, so anti-heal timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Real 28s cooldown used; the 2-second untargetable window stated; Grievous Wounds timing tied to Transfusion.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns both implied a fifteen-second Sanguine Pool.
audit.why: It is 28s at rank 1 — nearly double. That is the difference between a fleeting window and a full trade cycle.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] claimed Hemoplague's AoE burst outpaces 'your single-target combo'.
audit.why: Annie's W and Tibbers are both AoE, so the contrast is false. Hemoplague's real value is the damage amplification on everyone it tags.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave's worst-wave clause was the generic 'every assassin timer in the game' template.
audit.why: Vladimir is not an assassin. He clears a shoved wave for free with Tides of Blood and heals it back with Transfusion.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Molten Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1 — two seconds untargetable erases the back half of your combo, so bait it and commit on its cooldown. - Transfusion is free and heals: buy Grievous Wounds before your second item, not after it.

edits.before: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — that is a 28-second open door.
